I have the same problem. Let me know if it is not appropriate to respond in others' post.

My R environment is 
> sessionInfo()
R version 4.3.2 (2023-10-31)
Platform: aarch64-apple-darwin20 (64-bit)
Running under: macOS Ventura 13.4

I can successfully download the package from CRAN, but failed to use it in the following test example:

N <- 100 # 500, 5000, 25000, 100000
x <- rnorm(N, mean = 5, sd = 1)
nu <- rnorm(N, 0, 0.1)
mu <- exp(1 + 0.5 * x + nu)
y <- rpois(N, mu)
nu <- 1:N
inla(y ~ x + f(nu, model = "iid"),
     family = "poisson",
     data = data,
     control.predictor = list(link = 1)
)

The error message I got was also: "Error in inla.call.builtin() : INLA installation error; no such file".
